name: cable biceps curl (sz bar)
description: A standing cable curl with an SZ bar. The cable keeps constant tension on the biceps.
instructions: Attach an SZ bar to a low pulley and grip it with an underhand grip.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and avoid swinging your body.
